title: Safe in the Comfort of Thy Grace
description: Safe in the Comfort of Thy Grace in Tonic Solfa to HOLY MATRIMONY, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Particular Metre (8.8.6.8.8.6), and this page sets them to HOLY MATRIMONY; any other Common Particular Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Safe in the com-fort of Thy grace, Give me, O Lord, a rest-ing place, From ev-ery tu-mult free; From strife of sin, and sense of guilt, For lo, my con-fi-dence is built, Most gra-cious Lord, on Thee.

lines: Safe in the comfort of Thy grace,
Give me, O Lord, a resting place,
From every tumult free;
From strife of sin, and sense of guilt,
For lo, my confidence is built,
Most gracious Lord, on Thee.
There is no other comfort nigh,
And sad of heart I mourning sigh —
Lord, Thou alone canst aid;
Wilt Thou my prayer in anger spurn,
And from Thy trembling servant turn,
Whose soul is sore dismayed?
Nay, if I doubting, still believe,
Thou wilt my faulty prayer receive,
And grant the boon I crave;
For 'tis Thy promise I would claim,
And in the all-availing name
Of Him Who came to save.
So shall Thy peace my heart control,
And fill with calm my troubled soul,
My every tumult still;
And thus I learn to trust Thee more,
For billows surge, and tempests roar
Obedient at Thy will.
And in the shining of Thy face,
A man shall be an hiding place,
And covert from the wind;
And while the tempest breaks around,
I peaceful rest on tranquil ground,
Where Thou, O Lord, art kind.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to HOLY MATRIMONY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
